    • tryToExportEndpoint

      protected boolean tryToExportEndpoint(ZigBeeEndpoint newEndpoint)
      Checks if the passed endpoint has the same ID and the same IEEE address of an already registered exported ZigBeeEndpoint service. If this happens, the notExported method is called on the new endpoint to notify it that cannot be exported.
      Parameters:
      newEndpoint - A ZigBeeEndpoint that has been just registered.
      Returns:
      true if the endpoint can be exported successfully. It means that notExported() method has not been called on the new endpoint.
